serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: He’s there…
Hobo: Holy shit, that’s a big crowd. What did your friend do exactly to piss all of these people off?! 
You: I’m not sure… {{wi}}Let’s just say he has a strong personality.
Hobo: I can’t even see him in there. What does he look like?
You: You shouldn’t have a problem recognizing him, don’t worry about it.
Hobo:  Whatever. 
Hobo: What’s the plan then? We can’t really brawl it out. We would die.
You: I don’t have a plan, that’s why I came for your help.
Hobo: What?! Who do you think I am?! 
You: I thought you got some street-smarts.
Hobo: No amount of street-smarts would help here…
Hobo: I have only one idea. It could work, but it’s pretty dangerous.
You: Alright, let’s hear it.
Hobo: You will act as a distraction and I will take your friend to safety. How does that sound?
You: What?! Why do I get the most dangerous part?!
Hobo: Because that’s your friend! If you have any better ideas, please tell me about them.
You: …
Hobo: Thought so.
Hobo: Listen, you will have a head start and they all seem on drugs or just dead drunk. If you make a run for it, you should make it without a problem.
Hobo: Just make sure not to run too fast so that they won’t get discouraged. If they come back here before I saved your friend we will lose our only chance.
You: Yeah, I get it…
